articles.title: SEC opens door to tokenized U.S. stock trading. Here’s who could benefit
articles.snippet: The five-year experiment gives DeFi-style trading venues, tokenization firms and liquidity providers a new U.S. pathway while leaving synthetic stock tokens outside the framework.

articles.title: Zcash jumps 23% as bitcoin and major tokens rise despite Fed’s first hike since 2023
articles.snippet: Bitcoin traded above $76,000 as the Fed projected limited further tightening, while Paradigm’s Matt Huang discussed Zcash’s role as a privacy complement to bitcoin.

articles.title: CFTC Opens Door for Crypto Apps to Offer Regulated Derivatives Access
articles.snippet: In a no-action letter, the CFTC said certain software providers can connect users to regulated derivatives markets without registering as brokers.

articles.title: Ethereum Founder Vitalik Buterin Says AI Won’t Doom Crypto Security
articles.snippet: The Ethereum co-founder said AI could help developers mathematically verify entire software systems, turning the same technology powering new attacks into a tool for defense.

articles.title: Crypto Tax Bill Clears House Committee After Clarity Act Setback
articles.snippet: The bill would exempt qualifying crypto fees from gain-or-loss calculations and restrict tax-loss deductions on tokens sold and quickly repurchased.
